subtitles.summary: What the company spent this month, what's still to pay and where the money goes.
subtitles.movements: Everything that came in and went out of your accounts and cards. Internal transfers don't count as spending.
subtitles.fixed: What gets paid every month. Auto debit and card charges book themselves on their charge day.
subtitles.accounts: Your cards, bank accounts and petty cash, and the categories you sort spending into.
subtitles.import: Upload a card statement or your bank's transactions. You review everything before it's saved.
subtitles.cashflow: The next 13 weeks: what goes out (fixed expenses and installments) and what comes in (your clients' recurring revenue).

state.notConfigured: Expenses isn't configured on this server yet: the module's encryption key is missing.
state.noPermission: You don't have permission to see Expenses. By default only the account owner does.
state.noAccountsBody: A card, a bank account or petty cash. Every expense comes out of one.

summary.noPrevious: no data for the previous month
summary.estimatedNote_one: Includes {{count}} estimated charge the next import will confirm.
summary.estimatedNote_other: Includes {{count}} estimated charges the next import will confirm.
summary.allPaid: Every fixed expense for {{month}} is paid or booked.
summary.noFixed: You haven't added any fixed expenses yet.
summary.infoEncryptedBody: Descriptions, merchants, amounts, notes and account numbers. The module has its own key, separate from Payroll's.
summary.infoCsvBody: It's read in your browser for the preview. On confirm only the transactions are saved, already encrypted.
summary.infoWhoBody: Only roles with the "Manage expenses" permission (by default, the owner). Neither Northstack support nor the activity log shows amounts.

movements.rulesNote: Change an expense's category and a rule is created: similar ones get categorized automatically. Your rules: {{count}}.
movements.emptyBody: Add an expense by hand or import your bank or card statement.
movements.ruleApplied_one: Category saved. The rule also categorized {{count}} similar transaction.
movements.ruleApplied_other: Category saved. The rule also categorized {{count}} similar transactions.
movements.ruleSaved: Category saved. Similar ones will be categorized automatically.
movements.autoHint: Automatic charge of a fixed expense: change it from Fixed expenses.

fixed.emptyBody: Rent, utilities, fees, software: what gets paid every month.
fixed.infoAutoBody: On their charge day they book themselves as an estimated expense. Nothing to mark.
fixed.infoCsvBody: When you import the bank or card statement, the real transaction replaces the estimate (if the amount changed, the real one stays). No duplicates.
fixed.infoManualBody: Transfers or cash: mark them paid, or they reconcile automatically if they show up in the CSV.

fixedModal.name: Name
fixedModal.dayHint: If the month is shorter, it's charged on the last day.
fixedModal.accountHint: The card or account the payment comes out of.
fixedModal.activeHint: Paused stops booking it and showing it as due.

accounts.categoriesBody: The built-in ones show in your language. Yours, exactly as you typed them.

accountModal.name: Name
accountModal.nameHint: Stored encrypted. You can include the last 4 digits to recognize it.
accountModal.activeHint: An archived account doesn't show up when adding new expenses; its history is kept.

import.whichAccount: Which account is the file from?
import.cashHint: Cash expenses are usually entered by hand, but you can still import a spreadsheet.
import.savedFormat: This account's saved format: {{format}}. It's used right away.
import.firstImport: First import for this account: we detect the format and save it for next time.
import.uploadBody: It's read only in this browser. The file is never sent or stored anywhere.
import.noRows: We couldn't read any rows in that file. Check it has headers and at least one transaction.
import.tooManyRows: The file has more than {{max}} rows. Split it up (for example, one month per file).
import.fileInfo_one: File: {{name}} · {{count}} row · columns detected automatically, fix anything that's off.
import.fileInfo_other: File: {{name}} · {{count}} rows · columns detected automatically, fix anything that's off.
import.signTitle: What does “−” mean in this file?

reason.columns: The file has two separate columns, Debit and Credit, with no signs. We read each by its name.
reason.typeColumn: The file has a type column (D/C): we use it to tell expenses from credits.
reason.saved: We're using this account's saved format.
reason.negCredit: “−” appears on {{examples}}: payments or bonuses. In this file “−” means a credit, not an expense.
reason.negDebit: “−” appears on {{examples}}: debits, fees or taxes. In this file “−” means an expense.
reason.fallbackCard: No keywords to decide from; we used what's usual for a card. Check the preview.
reason.fallbackBank: No keywords to decide from; we used what's usual for a bank account. Check the preview.

import.signNote: We never store the sign: every transaction is saved as a positive amount plus a direction (debit or credit), so it doesn't matter how each bank exports it.

note.confirmsChanged: Confirms the automatic charge “{{name}}” · estimated {{estimated}}, the real amount is kept
note.internal: Card payment or own transfer: already counted on the other account

import.confirmOthers: {{internal}} internal transfers (saved, not counted) · {{duplicates}} duplicates skipped · {{reconciled}} fixed expenses matched
import.saveProfile: Save this format for {{account}} (next time it imports right away)
import.fileDiscarded: Transactions are saved encrypted. The file is discarded.

dashboard.empty: No expenses in this period. Add them by hand or import a card or bank CSV.
dashboard.topMerchantsHint: Purchases grouped by merchant (the same words the category rules use).

cashflow.openingHint: With today's balance you see week by week where you end up. It's only kept in this browser.
cashflow.negativeNetHint: more goes out than comes in
cashflow.alert: Heads up: the week of {{date}} goes into the red.
cashflow.howItWorks: Active fixed expenses on their charge day, the remaining installments of purchases in installments, and your clients' recurring product revenue on its day (with the Clients module). Company currency only.
cashflow.otherCurrency_one: {{count}} product in another currency was left out.
cashflow.otherCurrency_other: {{count}} products in another currency were left out.
